bimetric-degenerate-DHOST-like.why: THE surviving bimetric target: MOND nonlinearity and Hamiltonian degeneracy from the SAME structure
bimetric-degenerate-DHOST-like.known: the surviving target: MOND constitutive nonlinearity + Hamiltonian degeneracy from the SAME structure. Bi-DHOST / degenerate multi-metric is largely uncharted.
bimetric-degenerate-DHOST-like.implication: decisive first calc = quadratic Hamiltonian/ghost analysis of the degenerate two-metric interaction (does the constraint survive while the C-invariant gives the a0 scale?).

bimond-connection.why: C-invariant interaction; decisive gate = Hamiltonian/BD audit
bimond-connection.known: Milgrom BIMOND (0912.0790 + 2022 ext): interaction from C=Gamma(g)-Gamma(h); several quadratic C-invariants share the NR MOND limit, differ relativistically. Derivative bimetric interactions GENERICALLY ghosty (EPJC 2023).
bimond-connection.implication: decisive gate = Hamiltonian/BD audit of the C-invariant kinetic matrix. This IS a special case of bimetric-degenerate; attack them together.

DHOST-single-metric.why: degeneracy machinery exists; slip-lock applies unless matter-coupling nonminimal -- check
DHOST-single-metric.known: 3 DOF (2 tensor+1 scalar); ghost-free via Langlois-Noui degeneracy among the quadratic-in-2nd-deriv coefficients; INCLUDES mimetic + particular khronometric as limits (arXiv:1602.08398). Generic gravitational SLIP + minimal matter coupling.
DHOST-single-metric.implication: the DHOST scalar still couples through curvature => slip-lock (DC-013) likely APPLIES unless the higher-derivative structure opens a genuinely new (Phi-Psi) channel or matter coupling is nonminimal-but-single-metric. THAT is the open question to design the candidate around.

teleparallel.why: different connection; slip-lock derivation used Riemannian R -- re-derive
teleparallel.known: torsion-based (flat connection, R=0, dynamics in torsion T). f(T) BREAKS local Lorentz invariance and its extra DOF are known to be strongly-coupled/problematic on many backgrounds.
teleparallel.implication: slip-lock (DC-013) was derived on Riemannian R^(1) -- MUST be RE-DERIVED for torsion before G6 can apply; do NOT auto-kill. Cheapest decisive obstruction = the local-Lorentz/strong-coupling analysis of the extra torsion mode.

nonmetricity.known: symmetric teleparallel f(Q): flat + torsion-free, dynamics in nonmetricity Q. f(Q) has a known strong-coupling / extra-mode issue around maximally symmetric backgrounds.
nonmetricity.implication: same caveat -- slip-lock uses Riemannian R, re-derive for Q. Design target = whether Q-invariants can source the a0 scale with a healthy DOF count.

emergent-constitutive.why: effective-medium; needs a concrete action first
emergent-constitutive.known: effective-medium/constitutive-tensor gravity has no single canonical action; the closest concrete realizations reduce to Horndeski/vector-tensor on covariantization.
emergent-constitutive.implication: needs a CONCRETE action before any gate applies; highest-uncertainty region. Cheapest obstruction = does the covariantized action reduce to an already-classified family?

higher-curvature.why: f(R) gives slip eta=1/2 (killed for lensing) but mixed invariants unexplored
higher-curvature.known: f(R) alone = a scalaron with FIXED slip eta=1/2 (=> under-lenses, already covered by the slip-lock ray at L->specific). Mixed invariants f(R,R_mn R^mn) generically Ostrogradsky-ghosty unless degenerate.
higher-curvature.implication: pure f(R) is DEAD-for-lensing (slip-lock special case); the ONLY live sub-region is degenerate higher-curvature = overlaps DHOST. Low new information.

conformal-disformal-matter.why: disformal needs a vector (DC-005) but conformal+disformal COMBINATIONS with 2 metrics untested
conformal-disformal-matter.known: conformal coupling => photon-invisible (RAQUAL under-lens, DC-005-adjacent); disformal => needs a gradient/vector = a frame.
conformal-disformal-matter.implication: single scalar's conformal+disformal both fail frame-free (this session's pincer). The ONLY untested corner = TWO metrics with a composite (conformal g + disformal via the 2nd metric's gradient) -- overlaps the bimetric-degenerate target. Fold into bimetric.
